properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-28: "I don't think all the upgrading-to-v0.47.0.md type documents are needed (I believe https://github.com/sligara7/reflow2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md captures all the fine grain changes)."

WHAT THE DESIGN ALREADY HOLDS: CHANGELOG.md's versioning table says a Minor change to the schema or graph model "also needs an upgrade doc". That is a stated convention, not an accepted requirement (none was found). art:upgrading-v0550 records why one of these notes existed: "the first upgrade note whose action is REQUIRED of every consumer", with runnable migration commands and a verification step before the swap. Measured: 20 upgrade notes in docs/.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) RETIRE ALL: CHANGELOG is the record, and the notes live on in git history. Drop the "needs an upgrade doc" line from the versioning table.
(b) FOLD REQUIRED ACTIONS INTO THE CHANGELOG: an entry whose upgrade needs a consumer to DO something carries the steps itself (an "Upgrade action" line under the version). The per-version files go.
(c) ONE UPGRADING PAGE: a single page (on the site, if the site idea lands) listing only the versions that needed action, with their steps. Everything else is in CHANGELOG.
(d) KEEP AS IS.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
· Not every note is a summary. v0.55.0's note carries a REQUIRED migration: every existing graph was locked out until migrated, and the note's runnable commands include a verify-before-swap. A CHANGELOG entry that only says "QualityGate removed" loses exactly the part a consumer upgrading from 0.54 needs. (b) or (c) keeps it; (a) makes git history the only place to find it.
· Most notes probably ARE summaries of their CHANGELOG entry ("nothing is removed, an existing graph keeps working"). That supports retiring them. Which notes carry steps the CHANGELOG lacks was not measured here.
· Some are registered Artifacts, so they retire on the record rather than vanishing.

SIZE, AS INFORMATION: (a) is small. (b) is small to medium (read 20 notes and move any steps). (c) is medium.
properties.name: SETTLED — promoted into: CHANGELOG.md is the one record of what changed between versions, and no upgrade step a consumer must take is lost when the per-version upgrade notes retire
properties.no_relation_note: Searched "upgrade doc schema change upgrading-to version migration". Nearest were art:upgrading-v0550, chg:the-v0550-upgrade-note-says-it-is-superseded, rel:v0550 and chg:qualitygate-leaves-the-schema. Those are records of one note and its release, not ideas about the practice, so no relation is honestly drawn. The practice itself lives only as a line in CHANGELOG.md's versioning table.
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill with its answer-first step: the design was searched for an accepted rule requiring upgrade notes. None was found, only the CHANGELOG's stated convention and the v0.55.0 note's recorded reason for existing.
